description: Act on a ref, then wait for a predicate to hold — one hop for the act->observe->assert loop. e.g. {"ref":"e42","action":"click","until":{"kind":"signal","name":"todos:loaded"}}

args.description: Action-specific arguments: { value } for fill/select, { text } for type/press (the key NAME, e.g. Escape or Tab), { modifiers: ["Meta","Shift"] } for a press s…

durable.description: After a yes, reload and require the element/text/state part of `until` to hold again.

intent.description: What this change is meant to make true — as a durable statement ABOUT THE PRODUCT, or the id of an intent you already declared.

predicate.description: Predicate object: { kind, ...fields }. kind is one of element | text | net | route | console | animation | signal | state | settled | compare | allOf | anyOf | not. Bug-catching options: net.count (exact request count — catches double-submit), net.bodyMatches (a JSON field match on what the SERVER answered — say the FIELD (a dotted path reaches nested ones) and its value, because a substring of the body matches key names too), net.requestBodyMatches (the same on what the UI SENT — the verdict for "applying this filter actually puts it in the payload"), compare (page text vs server answer, no expected value: { left:{from:"text",scope}, right:{from:"net",urlContains,path}, as:"number" }), console.absent:true (action completed with a CLEAN console), absent:true on element/text (it should be gone). Call reticle_tools for the full field grammar of a kind.

ref.description: Element ref (e.g. 'e42') from reticle_look { action: "page" }/reticle_look { action: "find" } — stable until the element leaves the DOM, so no re-snapshot between actions.

refuseWhenThrottled.description: Throw if the tab is throttled.

sessionId.description: Target a specific tab. Omit unless you mean one — see instructions.

target.description: Find the element and act on it in ONE call, instead of a reticle_look { action: "find" } round trip first: { testid } | { text } | { role, name } | { label }.

until.description: Predicate object: { kind, ...fields }. kind is one of element | text | net | route | console | animation | signal | state | settled | compare | allOf | anyOf | not.

name: reticle_act_and_wait
